ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PixelGuard reads your photos to copy them to your PC.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: PixelGuard brings back to your iPhone the photos you pick on your PC.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: PixelGuard reads the code shown by your PC to connect to it. No photo is taken.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: PixelGuard looks for your PC on your home Wi-Fi and copies your photos to it. Nothing leaves your network.
